info.title: ZK-VOTE Relayer API
info.description: Backend relayer for anonymous voting on Stellar/Soroban. Generated from route definitions and Zod validation schemas — see backend/API.md for prose docs and GET /api-docs for interactive documentation.

RelayerAuth.name: X-Relayer-Auth
RelayerAuth.description: Shared relayer auth token (also accepted as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`). There is currently one shared token per deployment, not per-user credentials.
